# Neutrino's Blog

> Liu, An-Chi's blog

Author: Liu, An-Chi 劉安齊. Topics: software engineering, systems & high-performance programming, C++, Rust, compilers and open source. Original posts are in Traditional Chinese (zh-TW); selected posts are also translated into English and Japanese.

## Posts

- [中堅工程師奮鬥中（一）：開始成為公司的中堅力量](https://tigercosmos.xyz/post/2026/07/software-engineer/mid-dev-fight-1/): 本文介紹我成為中堅工程師的第一份感想，在 T2 經歷半年多後，從開發速度、賺錢指標、影響力、學習成長等層面去描述我身為中堅工程師的各種心態轉變。
